title: refactor(plugin-auth): move AuthManager's MCP access-token verifier into auth-manager-mcp-access-token.ts (#25224 cut 9)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMjbPDrsigsyqoKsV4WZQMz)_

Part of #25224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160, 6364006498

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line: this is a move. No accept set, route, refusal, code or answer changes, and the published surface is measured unchanged at both commits:
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are raw byte-identical to base at commit 1 and at head (0 diff lines, so the union-order normalisation has nothing to do). The positive control is the one ruling `6348891160` asks for.
- Its ESM and CJS entries export the same 159 names at base, at commit 1 and at head.

The `.d.ts` bar is ruling `6348891160` item 1 (on #25222, covering this card). Ruling `6364006498` is Sales's ruling A on this card, for bodies that read shared unexported helpers. This is the first cut it applies to.

Cut 9 of the `auth-manager.ts` split: **the MCP access-token verifier.** Two `AuthManager` method bodies (94 lines) and the one module-level declaration only they read (11 lines) move unedited, re-indented one level, into one new module, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-mcp-access-token.ts`. #25224 stays open for the later cuts.

This follows the amended claim `6367866058`, which amends `6365318480` on the file cut 8 left (#25423, landed note `6366862591`). The shape is cuts 1 to 8's, which is #23050's.

Branch: `claude/project-thread-lg3wrj`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` `2b7c331537` after #25423 merged. It names no issue, so the card relation is this body's first line.

`auth-manager.ts` goes from 8,790 to 8,711 lines. The cut is +247 / −112 over 4 files: 359 changed lines, under the 3,000-line line. It is not a governed surface (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of the 4 paths hit the register).

There are two commits, so the `index.ts` change is measured by itself:
- `b048a93241`: `index.ts` names `auth-manager.ts`'s published exports, and one comment sentence is reworded;
- `619494870b`: the move.

## Commit 1: `index.ts` names what it publishes from `auth-manager.ts`

Ruling `6364006498`, parameter 1. `index.ts:16` was `export * from './auth-manager.js';`, so any module-level helper exported from `auth-manager.ts` for a module split out of it would have been published. It is now an explicit `export { … } from './auth-manager.js';` of the 14 names `auth-manager.ts` exports at base, in declaration order:

`DEFAULT_AUTH_BASE_PATH`, `readMcpServerEnabledEnv`, `resolveOidcProviderEnabled`, `resolveDcrEnabled`, `resolveScimEnabled`, `assertScimAdminCoherence`, `isOAuthEligibleBaseUrl`, `type InvitationPlacementServiceLike`, `readInvitationPlacementIntent`, `type AuthManagerOptions`, `ipMatchesRange`, `normalizeAuthEmailLocale`, `authEmailLocaleFromRequest`, `AuthManager`.

A four-line comment above it says a new export of `auth-manager.ts` is published only by adding it there. The list was read off the base file with the TypeScript compiler API: 14 exported declarations, exactly these, in this order. At head the file has 15, and the fifteenth, `OAUTH_ORGANIZATION_CLAIM` (commit 2), is not listed.

**One comment-only reword, agreed with the seat.** Cut 5's module header (`auth-manager-email-sms-delivery.ts:45`–`:49`) said "`index.ts` re-exports `auth-manager.ts` whole, so exporting them from there would add them to the published surface, and a value import of that file from here would be a cycle." This commit makes the first half false, and the PR would otherwise ship a statement it makes false. The sentence now reads:

> The four module-level declarations move with the bodies rather than being imported back, because only these bodies read them. (`index.ts` lists the names it publishes from `auth-manager.ts` one by one, so a helper exported there in place for a module split out of it stays off the published surface.) Nothing re-exports this module, so the published surface does not move.

- The cycle half is dropped. A value import of `auth-manager.ts` from a split module is a cycle, but cuts 8 and 9 take one by design, read only inside function bodies, so it is no longer a reason. "Only these bodies read them" is measured: none of the four names (`SMS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE`, `isSmsQuotaRefusal`, `smsQuotaExceededApiError`, `PHONE_OTP_SEND_REFUSAL_CODE`) has a reader in `auth-manager.ts`.
- Neither the old nor the new wording cites an `ADR-NNNN`, with or without a decision letter: 0 and 0.
- The file's token sequence is unchanged: 1,427 tokens before and after, compared with the template-aware scanner the move proof uses (trivia skipped), and a comment-free print of the file is identical. Negative control: one string token changed (`'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS'` → `'TOO_MANY_REQUEST'`) makes both comparisons fail, exit 1.

**What commit 1 changes in the build**, measured at `b048a93241`:
- `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are raw byte-identical to base;
- the ESM and CJS entries export the same 159 names;
- `index.js` and `index.mjs` are byte-identical to base. Only `index.js.map` and `index.mjs.map` move, because `index.ts`'s lines moved.

## Commit 2: the move

| moved | base line | lines | members it reads |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `verifyMcpAccessToken` (public) | `:7228` | 74 | `getApi`, `getAuthIssuer`, `getMcpResourceUrl`, `isMcpOAuthEnabled`, `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` |
| `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` (private) | `:7321` | 20 | `config`, and `unknownKeyReread` (read and written) |
| `readPublishedJwks` (module-level, with its docblock) | `:1483`–`:1493` | 11 | — |

Lines are base `2b7c331537`. The members come from a walk of every `this.X` in each body with the TypeScript compiler API. No body has a bare `this`, `this[...]`, `arguments` or `super`, or a `this` inside a `function` or a nested class. The one member a body assigns is `unknownKeyReread` (`rereadKeyringForUnknownKey`).

- **`verifyMcpAccessToken`** is the local, fail-closed check of an OAuth 2.1 Bearer access token this deployment's authorization server minted: the signature against the published key set, `iss`, `aud`, the refusal of a token no human delegated, and the organization claim.
- **`rereadKeyringForUnknownKey`** is the one forced keyring re-read a token signed by an unknown key earns, single-flight and floored at `UNKNOWN_SIGNING_KEY_REREAD_FLOOR_MS`.
- **`readPublishedJwks` moves with them, unexported.** It reads the key set `/jwks` publishes. Its only readers are the two moved bodies (`:7238`, `:7329`). No anchor anywhere in the tree names it, and no test reads it. Its docblock cites `[#24186]` and no ADR.

**`OAUTH_ORGANIZATION_CLAIM` is exported in place** (ruling `6364006498`, parameter 2):
- `:1465` becomes `export const OAUTH_ORGANIZATION_CLAIM = 'organization_id';`. That is the only edit to text that stays.
- It does not move. `buildPluginList` (`:4398`, which stays) mints the claim with it, and `verifyMcpAccessToken` (`:7288`) reads it back; its docblock calls it "one spelling for both ends".
- The new module imports it by value from `./auth-manager.js`, beside `type AuthManager`. The one read is inside `verifyMcpAccessToken`'s body, when a token is verified. The module's top level is three imports, `readPublishedJwks`, the host interface and the two functions, so nothing reads the binding while the two modules are first evaluated.
- `index.ts` (commit 1) does not list it, so it is not published. The head's ESM and CJS entries do not export it, and `dist/index.d.ts` does not name it.

**Imports.**
- `retireHeldKeyrings` and `UNKNOWN_SIGNING_KEY_REREAD_FLOOR_MS` (`./signing-key-read-cache.js`) leave `auth-manager.ts`, where their only reader was `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey`'s body, and that import line goes. The two docblock mentions of `UNKNOWN_SIGNING_KEY_REREAD_FLOOR_MS` that stay in the class are backticked text, not `{@link}`.
- `type JSONWebKeySet` (`jose`) stays in `auth-manager.ts`, for the `unknownKeyReread` field and the `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` signature. The new module imports it as well.
- The `await import('jose')` inside `verifyMcpAccessToken` moves with the body.

**Evaluation order.** `signing-key-read-cache.js` was first reached through `auth-manager.ts`'s own import line (`:146`). It is now first reached through `auth-manager-plugin-assembly.js`, which imports `createSigningKeyReader` from it (cut 6's import line, `:221` at head). Its top level is one type-only import, literal constants, a `Set`, a `WeakMap`, interfaces and function declarations. It imports no value and does nothing outside itself, so the change in order cannot be observed.

## The shape

- **The class keeps both methods** at their places, with their names, signatures and docblocks: the published `.d.ts` lists each one. Each body is now a host literal of exactly the members that body reads, typed as a `Pick` of `McpAccessTokenHost`, plus `.call`.
- **`McpAccessTokenHost`** lives in the new module. It names the 7 members the bodies read, each typed as the class member (`AuthManager['config']`, …).
- **Every method goes as a late-bound closure** (`(...a) => this.m(...a)`), so a double or spy set on the manager is still the one a body reaches. The verifier suites replace `getApi` with a key-set double, and `verifyMcpAccessToken` asks `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` through the manager rather than calling the function directly.
- **`config` goes as a getter.** The class reassigns it after construction (`setRuntimeBaseUrl`, `applyConfigPatch`), so it is read off the manager when a body reads it, as before.
- **`unknownKeyReread` goes as a get/set pair.** `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` stores the re-read it starts on the manager, so the floor and the read in flight stay the manager's, shared by every token it verifies.
- **`verifyMcpAccessToken` is no longer `async`.** It returns the moved async function's own promise, so a caller awaits the same promise the body settles. Building the host cannot throw, so it does not now throw synchronously where it used to reject. `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` was not `async` and stays so.
- **The cost:** one small host object per call, on MCP bearer-token verification only, not on every request.
- **Nothing re-exports the new module**, so the published surface does not move.

## Path readers

No path reader needs migrating: none reads a moved line.
- **The tenant-audit census.** No census site moves: the moved text has no engine write, no `this.X.delete()` and no elevation read. `check-tenant-audit-census` exits 0 at head with no `--write`: 238 sites at base and at head, compared per site with line numbers ignored, 0 differences, and 2 of them in `auth-manager.ts` at both. So neither census document is edited.
- **`check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs`** and **`api-error-code.pin.test.ts`'s `authManagerFiles` floor**: no `new APIError(` sits in the moved text. The gate reads 56 sites found and 56 classified at base and at head.
- **The plugin-factory scans** in `better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts` and `managed-extension-fields.test.ts` match `await import('better-auth/plugins…')` and `await import('@better-auth/…')` only. The moved `await import('jose')` is neither, and the import lines that change are local modules.
- **`check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs`** and **`auth-manager-base-path.test.ts`**: no base-path literal or declaration sits in the moved text. `getAuthIssuer` and `getMcpResourceUrl` stay on the class.
- **The system-context census** reads 148 elevation read sites at base and at head.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/`**: the `auth-manager.ts` entry's invariant (ADR-0093, ADR-0108) is about the organization roles and the membership reconciler, not this text.
- **Callers through the manager.** These suites drive the two methods through the class method, and all pass at head:
  - `auth-manager.mcp-oauth.test.ts` (local JWKS verification, fail-closed);
  - `auth-manager.mcp-verifier-keyring.test.ts` (the forced re-read, its floor and single flight; it reads `UNKNOWN_SIGNING_KEY_REREAD_FLOOR_MS` and `retireHeldKeyrings` from `signing-key-read-cache.js` itself);
  - `auth-manager.oauth-consent-organization.test.ts` (the organization claim end to end);
  - `auth-manager.mcp-oauth-resource.test.ts`.
- **Every symbol anchor into the file.** Before the cut, every `auth-manager.ts#symbol` anchor in the tracked tree outside changelogs was mapped with `symbolSegmentResolution` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`. There are 29, and all 29 are `declaration`-class at base, with the moved text blanked, and at head. None names a moved method or `readPublishedJwks`. One names a token the moved text carries, and it resolves on the declaration that stays: `#isMcpOAuthEnabled` (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json:806`; the moved verifier calls `this.isMcpOAuthEnabled()`).

## The decision-letter layer does not move

The seat asks each cut's report for this count at both ends. `check-adr-anchors`' decision-letter layer reads 2,001 at base `2b7c331537` and 2,001 at head, and the gate exits 0 at both. Nothing this PR adds or moves cites an `ADR-NNNN`: not the moved text, not the new module's header, not the `index.ts` comment, and not the reworded sentence. So the number layer reads the same at both: 52,177 citations across 6,637 files. No anchor entry is added for the new module, as for cuts 1 to 8's modules.

## Proof

Builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`, and every exit code was captured before any pipe. Base `2b7c331537`, commit 1 `b048a93241`, head `619494870b`. A full `turbo run build` ran first. Then `plugin-auth` was built and its suite run at base, built at commit 1, and built and its suite run at head, on the same dependency dists.

**1. The moved text.**
- For each of the 2 methods, the base class body and the new module's function body are the same TypeScript token sequence (scanner tokens, kind and text, trivia skipped, each template literal re-scanned at its substitutions as the parser does).
- Every line is the base line minus exactly two leading spaces, and the parameters and return type are the same text.
- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, with `async` dropped from `verifyMcpAccessToken`.
- `readPublishedJwks`'s 11 lines, docblock included, are verbatim in the module and absent from `auth-manager.ts`. Its 76 tokens are identical.
- Result: 2 of 2 bodies and 1 of 1 declarations pass, 94 body lines plus 11.

| moved | lines | tokens |
|---|---:|---:|
| `verifyMcpAccessToken` | 74 | 434 |
| `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey` | 20 | 130 |
| `readPublishedJwks` | 11 | 76 |

- **Negative control:** one token changed in the module (`errors.JWKSNoMatchingKey` → `errors.JWKSNoMatchingKeys` in `verifyMcpAccessToken`) makes that method fail (tokens and lines DIFFER), and the run exits 1. The module was restored afterwards, and `cmp` against the saved copy was clean.
- **An independent reading:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change b048a93241 619494870b` over the two source files marks 105 of the 107 deleted lines and 120 of the 222 added lines as moved.
  - The other 2 deleted lines are `const OAUTH_ORGANIZATION_CLAIM = …` (now `export const`) and the `async verifyMcpAccessToken(` signature line.
  - The other added lines are the stubs' host literals, `McpAccessTokenHost`, the module header, the per-function pointer docblocks and the import blocks.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports (ruling `6348891160` items 1 and 2).**

| file | base | commit 1 | head | raw diff lines vs base |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| `dist/index.d.ts` raw | `12679e13f74973b0510551a65b50808e7c3936a2d273cf2f262a9196648c0737` | same | same | 0 and 0 |
| `dist/index.d.ts` normalised | `c7a9fa25f118cfec858d770b979767744d27d9757a9ea4063faeea6238c33c01` | same | same | |
| `dist/index.d.mts` raw | `df57562ff950159e738d790cb7ee82a655ba0fffddafe4153bdcc50c4537336f` | same | same | 0 and 0 |
| `dist/index.d.mts` normalised | `68f824aea0947d9895b968ed46a7972eaae43ef0f2bda7e3ba9113002233ade6` | same | same | |

- The normaliser, verbatim (the ruling's one-liner): `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`.
- The raw files are already byte-identical, so no union-order swap occurs in this cut: items 1(b) and 1(d) hold with nothing to account for.
- **Positive control:** the head `dist/index.d.ts` with one private member made public (`private rereadKeyringForUnknownKey;` → `rereadKeyringForUnknownKey;`, line 3320, a one-line change) hashes raw `090e9f39924a2034bc496e4fded90d5f267d90ff88aa20a92619d04019ed471b` and normalised `dc9fc90b5a1699dcb01263f89e1c983da7367710ea2c0f6e17ec395a9d0da579`. Both differ from the readings above.
- **Export lists:** ESM `dist/index.mjs` and CJS `dist/index.js` each have 159 names at base, at commit 1 and at head, the same list (the sha256 of the sorted names is `3abb126f5babb701…` on all six). `OAUTH_ORGANIZATION_CLAIM`, `readPublishedJwks` and the module's functions are not among them, and `dist/index.d.ts` names none of them.
- **The bundle:** 18 files in `dist/` at all three, the same list. From base to head, only `index.js`, `index.mjs` and their two `.map` files differ, as a move of code inside the bundle must. From base to commit 1, only the two `.map` files differ.

**3. Tests and lint.**
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: base `Test Files 189 passed (189)`, `Tests 3580 passed | 10 skipped (3590)`, exit 0. Head: the same counts, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (both `tsc` projects and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` (the root `lint` script's binary and flags) over the 4 source files: exit 0.

**4. The censuses and the anchors, at base and at head.**
- The tenant-audit census, as above: 238 sites at both, 0 per-site differences, 0 unresolved and 0 unledgered at both, and every total the same. Only `scannedSources` (725 → 726, the new module) and `measuredAt` differ.
- These checkers were run by hand at base and at head, because `dispatch-gates` does not derive the ADR one. All six exit 0 at both, with the same reading:
  - `check-adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,384 anchors across 142 records, 466 symbol (440 declaration, 26 literal);
  - `check-adr-anchors`: 80 anchored files; the decision-letter layer reads 2,001, as above;
  - `check-scripts-symbol-anchors`: 4,062 anchors;
  - `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`: 5,075 anchors (both of these read in the same built tree);
  - `check-system-context-census`: 148 elevation read sites;
  - `check-platform-checklist`: 16 areas, 329 items.

**5. Gates.**
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 commands for the 4 paths. All 53 ran at `619494870b` after the full build, and all 53 exited 0.
- `--ran` over the record with each exit code: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 359 changed lines.
- **Docs drift** (`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2b7c331537`, exit 0): 1 page, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/auth-service.mdx`, which states the `verifyMcpAccessToken` contract signature. The class method keeps that signature, so no doc edit is owed. 0 release-owned pages.
- **Serial constraints** (in the claim): 25 PRs are open, and none touches this cut's files or a reader above. `origin/main` moved to `b2c0752900` during the run with #25434, which touches `otp-send-guard.ts` and `rate-limit-storage.ts` and its test, none of them in this surface. `git merge-tree` of this branch onto `b2c0752900` is clean.

## Finding, outside this cut

`scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` is a measurement, not a gate. Its prose at `:625` and `:775` names `auth-manager.ts::verifyMcpAccessToken` as the one outstanding DARK member. The census does not list it on base: its one `auth-manager.ts` DARK member is `observeFirstMemberships`. So that prose was already stale before this cut.

Its `--json` reading is the same at base and at head: 74 members at both, every member and quiet row the same (line numbers ignored), and every statistic the same except the scanned file count (3,449 → 3,450, the new module). Neither side names `verifyMcpAccessToken` or the new module. `scripts/` is not edited, and the finding is for the seat to judge.

## Changeset

None: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4. The published declarations and export lists are unchanged, and the bundle's bytes move only because code moved inside it.
